title: Half-yearly return of outstanding payments to micro and small enterprise suppliers (Form MSME-1)
rules: Specified Companies (Furnishing of information about payment to micro and small enterprise suppliers) Order, 2019
subject: ENTITY

periodicity.note: KNOWN MODELLING GAP, left in deliberately: the real rule is 'due one calendar month after each half-year end' — 31 Oct for the Apr-Sep half, 30 Apr for the Oct-Mar half. A single offset_days value can't express both exactly (31 days after 30 Sep = 31 Oct, correct; 31 days after 31 Mar = 1 May, one day past the real 30 Apr deadline). Periodicity currently has no 'add one calendar month' anchor mode. Fix before shipping: either add that anchor mode, or split this into two ONE_TIME-per-half obligation records with FIXED_DATE anchors like DPT-3's. Flagged DRAFT for this reason, independent of the citation accuracy.

penalty: Fine on the company and every officer in default under s.405(4).
